digest.component_or_area: plan-review verdict generation and failure routing
propositions: Malformed criteria configuration raises CriteriaError during plan_review_assemble_criteria, but the generic workflow recorder discards typed exception identity and preserves only a string, causing downstream verdict generation to misclassify it as an LLM outage.

The degraded verdict builder unconditionally stamps llm_unavailable=true for every unrecognized workflow failure, regardless of whether any LLM tier executed, violating the original epic jira-reb-687 contract that scopes unavailable disposition to LLM-call failures only.

Criteria assembly must emit a structured failure_kind marker (criteria_config) at the exception boundary and verdict dispatch must route only that exact marker away from generic LLM degradation to a dedicated config-fault path, preserving deterministic findings and fail-closed behavior without false llm_unavailable labels.

The config-fault verdict must explicitly name the running installed rebar build as suspect and direct operators to use the repository checkout build, with actionable diagnostic text derived from the original parse error without string-match classification.
Genuine LLMUnavailableError and healthy provider paths must remain byte-for-byte unchanged, and deterministic blockers must not be masked by config-fault indeterminacy.
